The pathfinder can't even reach an adjacent walkable tile because it starts from a blocked tile. The engine's movement is blocked because I'm standing on the Notice Board.

Let me try one more idea: maybe the notice board can be "read" to open a panel, and closing it might reposition me. Or maybe pressing E while facing the board (on my tile) does nothing. 

Actually, let me reconsider — perhaps the notice board is NOT on my tile but the pathfinder is buggy. The observe said notice at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7). Let me try raw movement in the direction away from the player and board — down to (2,8) which is open.
